description: [S1.4, kind `port`] cov_r_tutorial run five virtual seconds past its Esc-load (a checkpoint `end` at T 132714, 5 s after esc_load at T 127563; the version of the scenario that still held it) diverges in the port at boot record 1244 of 1247, T 1181140: g_golfers, g_shotTargetX, g_shotTargetY and g_rng differ from the original (the three frames before the end checkpoint; every earlier record, including the load of the Tutorial Save.sve file the tutorial wrote at page 29, is equal). A shot target choice with an RNG draw differs; which function and which input is not determined. The shipped scenario stops at esc_load, where all 1,195 records are equal.
path to resolution: Re-add the five sleeps and the `end` checkpoint to cov_r_tutorial in a copy (log/roadmap/S1/4_boot_tutorial_long_FAIL.log has the failing run), run boot with SG_TICK_DUMP on chooseShotTarget / prepareShot, and compare the golfer record with the original's frame images (re/tools/frame_trace.py cmp).

description: [S1.4, kind `input`] In cov_r_flic_input the original's rootWin_onKey (call log, return address 0x0047c67e) runs inside loadFlic's 15th pumpInput483bd0 call of the load (14 earlier loadFlic calls, each with a pump, dispatched nothing; all 15 at one virtual T, since the load makes no clock read), although the key was posted by the harness before the first of them. The port takes the dispatch at the first load pump (PumpKind::Load takes it at the first pump that finds it deliverable); the sim hashes of all 75 records are equal, so no record separates the 1st from the 15th pump. Why the first 14 pumps leave a posted message queued is not determined (the pump's phase word 0x0083ad4c = 0x3f and its showScreen loop are not read here).
path to resolution: Read pumpInput483bd0 (0x00483bd0) and jgld's showScreen loop for the condition that lets a pump dispatch (a pending flag set by a timer or a counter), then take the batch at the same pump in the port.

description: [S1.4, kind `coverage`] No instruction stores a nonzero value in g_tutorialPage: the nine dword operands of 0x00567a18 in golf_clean.exe are mainLoop's reset (0x0041c119 stores edi = 0) and showTutorialText's reads, increments and resets (0x004604f0 .. 0x00460d5d; byte scan of the .text section, log/roadmap/S1/4_notes.md), and the save format holds no field covering it (re/model/sve_fields.tsv). Register-relative or block writes into that word are not excluded by this scan. cov_r_tutorial therefore sets the page with a harness write (g_tutorialPage, the way cov_b_location writes the date), and bit 15 of g_flags with a harness read-modify-write: the pages are judged as code, not as a path a player can take.
path to resolution: Watch 0x00567a18 for writes during a long run of the original (a hardware write watchpoint, one page of the exe's .data does not isolate it), or scan every `rep stos` / `rep movs` and indexed store whose destination range can include it.
